supported: Top-level inline embedded pictures in linked headers and footers and in referenced normal footnotes and endnotes. The original story XML must match the unedited WordCraft serialization; each eligible picture has synchronized, in-range source extents, a story-owned internal image relationship and unchanged image bytes.
